title: Word transformations and stdin CLI
goal: Add tested word transformations to src/words.js, then provide a tested CLI that reads standard input and reports all three results.
rules: Use `npm test` to run the tests; add no dependency.
Do not change what countWords returns.

decisions.question: What is a word?
decisions.decision: A nonempty sequence separated by whitespace, as countWords does.

decisions.question: What does the CLI print?
decisions.decision: Exactly three labeled lines: Word count, Reversed, Capitalized.
decisions.reason: A fixed format can be asserted in a test.

checkpoints.title: Add word transformations and unit tests
todos: Export reverseWords(text) and capitalizeWords(text) from src/words.js, preserving the existing countWords behavior.
Extend src/words.test.js to cover ordinary input, repeated and surrounding whitespace, empty and whitespace-only input, punctuation, mixed case and a non-ASCII initial character.

verify.expected: Existing count test and new transformation tests pass.

checkpoints.title: Add and test the stdin CLI
todos: Add src/cli.js to read stdin through EOF as UTF-8 and print the three results using the stated labels and line format.
Add CLI integration tests that spawn `node src/cli.js`, supply stdin, and assert exit status and exact stdout.

verify.expected: Unit and CLI integration tests pass; each CLI case exits successfully and produces exactly the specified output.
